description: This source file defines the TestAzureTableStorageStreamFailureHandler class, which provides mechanisms to handle stream failure events and retrieve failure counts using Azure Table Storage in a testing environment.

classes.name: TestAzureTableStorageStreamFailureHandler
classes.description: A specialized failure handler for Azure Table Storage streams used in testing scenarios, managing failure data and operational options.

methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the failure handler and performs any necessary setup asynchronously.
